decisions.reason: Two years on the market is still early for a lever handle family in a coordinated range, and with no reported shortfall the firm's slack lets it carry the line without problemistic search.
The mitred family adds design differentiation at low incremental cost, and no evidence suggests performance below aspiration, so retention is the default.
The multifunctional handle supports the strategic barrier-free direction, so management tolerates uncertain results while it builds specification in projects.
Shared tooling and finishing make the line cheap to carry, and absent a clear shortfall there is no trigger to drop it.
The award-winning collection with its own page clearly exceeds aspirations and anchors the design-led portfolio.
The bronze finish leverages in-house surface expertise across families at minimal cost and fits sustainable, architecture-aware positioning.
